Container.Name: aios-face
Container.Overview:
aios-face is a JARVIS-style web front end for a self-hosted AI stack: chat with tool calling, push-to-talk and hands-free voice, image / image-edit / 3D-model generation, an arc-reactor landing screen, a particle hologram, and live server metrics.
It is a THIN CLIENT. It holds no models, memory or tools of its own. It talks to services you already run:
* LibreChat (required) - chat and every tool, through LibreChat's Agents API. You need a saved agent (model + tools) and an Agent API key from LibreChat Settings > Data & Privacy > Agent API Keys. * imagegen-mcp bridge (required for images/3D) - an MCP server over streamable-http exposing generate_image, edit_image and generate_3d_model (backed by ComfyUI). * kokoro-fastapi (text to speech) and speaches (speech to text) - OpenAI-compatible voice services on your LAN. The face works as text-only if these are missing. * Unraid API (optional) - CPU / memory / array gauges in the status bar. Create a read-only key under Settings > Management Access > API Keys.
The image is published at ghcr.io/jbowensii/aios-face and is pulled automatically; Unraid shows updates in the Docker tab like any other container.
=== HTTPS IS REQUIRED FOR THE MICROPHONE === Browsers only allow microphone access on https:// (or localhost). Put this container behind your reverse proxy with a valid certificate and open it by that hostname. Plain http://TOWER-IP:3055 works for text and images but the mic button will not.
=== SECURITY === The LibreChat API key acts as the user who created it. Keep this container LAN-only; do not expose it to the internet.
=== REVERSE PROXY NOTE === Bridge networking on host port 3055 suits most setups. If your reverse proxy runs as an ipvlan container on a custom Docker network, it cannot reach published bridge ports on its own host - switch Network to that custom network and give this container its own static IP instead.
Container.Requires: A running LibreChat with a saved agent and an Agent API key. Optional: imagegen-mcp bridge, kokoro-fastapi, speaches, Unraid API key. See the README.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to the container HTTP port (3000). Put your HTTPS reverse proxy in front of this.

Config.Name: LibreChat URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your LibreChat, reachable from this container, e.g. http://192.168.1.43:3080 (no trailing slash).

Config.Name: LibreChat Agent API key
Config.Description: SET THIS. Create it in LibreChat under Settings > Data & Privacy > Agent API Keys. It acts as your LibreChat user.

Config.Name: LibreChat Agent ID
Config.Description: The saved agent the face talks to, e.g. agent_AbC123... (shown in the agent builder / returned by GET /api/agents/v1/models). Give it a tool-capable model and only the tools you need; huge tool sets exceed small models' context.

Config.Name: Image bridge MCP URL
Config.Description: Streamable-http MCP endpoint of the imagegen-mcp bridge, e.g. http://192.168.1.43:8195/mcp. Leave blank to disable image/3D generation.

Config.Name: Speech-to-text URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of your STT service (speaches / faster-whisper-server), e.g. http://192.168.1.43:8790/v1. Leave blank for text-only.

Config.Name: Speech-to-text model
Config.Description: Whisper model id installed on the STT service. Small is fast on CPU (~3 s per sentence); large models are far slower.

Config.Name: Text-to-speech URL
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of your TTS service (kokoro-fastapi), e.g. http://192.168.1.43:8880/v1. Leave blank for text-only.

Config.Name: Text-to-speech voice
Config.Description: Kokoro voice id. bm_george / bm_lewis are British male, am_michael American male, af_heart female. GET /v1/audio/voices on the TTS service lists them.

Config.Name: Unraid GraphQL URL
Config.Description: Optional. http://TOWER-IP/graphql of the Unraid server whose CPU/memory/array you want in the status bar.

Config.Name: Unraid API key
Config.Description: Optional read-only key from Settings > Management Access > API Keys. Blank hides the metrics panel.
